[[File:Spencer Weart 2006.jpg|thumb|Spencer R. Weart]]
'''Spencer R. Weart''' (born 1942) is the former director of the Center for History of Physics of the [[American Institute of Physics]] (AIP) from 1971 until his retirement in 2009. Originally trained as a physicist, he is now a historian of science.<ref name=AIP>{{cite web |url=http://history.aip.org/climate/author.htm |title=American Institute of Physics' biographical note on Spencer Weart |website=aip.org |publisher=[[American Institute of Physics]] |access-date=September 13, 2016 }}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Weart earned his B.A. in Physics at [[Cornell University]] in 1963 and a Ph.D. in Physics and [[Astrophysics]] at the [[University of Colorado]], Boulder, in 1968. He then did [[postdoctoral studies]] at the [[Hale Observatories]] and the [[California Institute of Technology]], publishing papers on [[solar physics]].

From 1971 to 1974, Weart studied the [[history of science]] at the [[University of California, Berkeley]].

==Career==
While serving as the director of the AIP Center for History of Physics, located at AIP headquarters in [[College Park, Maryland]], Weart taught courses at [[Johns Hopkins University]] and [[Princeton University]].

=== Oral history interviews ===
Weart conducted [[oral history]] interviews of many physical scientists, particularly astrophysicists, such as [[Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar]] (1977),<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aip.org/history-programs/niels-bohr-library/oral-histories/4551-1|title = S. Chandrasekhar - Session I|date = 12 January 2015}}</ref> and [[climate science|climate scientists]], such as [[Wallace Broecker]] (1997).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.aip.org/history-programs/niels-bohr-library/oral-histories/31675|work=Niels Bohr Library & Archives, American Institute of Physics|title=Interview of Wallace Broecker by Spencer Weart|year=1997}}</ref>

== Works ==
Weart has produced numerous historical articles and two children's science books and written or co-edited eleven other books,<ref>[http://www.aip.org/history/climate/Weart-Bibliog.htm Weart's list of publications]</ref> including the following: 
*''Scientists in Power'' (1979). A history of the rise of nuclear science, weapons, and reactors in France. {{ISBN|0-674-79515-6}}<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=7goAAAAAMBAJ&pg=PA41|date=March 1979|title=excerpts from ''Scientists in Power: France and the Origins of Nuclear Energy, 1900–1950'' by S. R. Weart|journal=Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists|volume=35|issue=3|pages=41–50|doi=10.1080/00963402.1979.11458599|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|title=Review of ''Scientists in Power'' by S. R. Weart|author=Bromberg, Joan|date=18 May 1979|journal=Science|volume=204|issue=4394|pages=741–742|doi=10.1126/science.204.4394.741|pmid=17840238|bibcode=1979Sci...204..741W}}</ref>
*as editor with Gertrud Weiss Szilard: ''Leo Szilard: His Version of the Facts'' (1978). Edited correspondence. {{ISBN|0-262-69070-5}}<ref>{{cite journal|journal=Science & Society|volume=44|issue=1|date=Spring 1980|title=Review of ''Leo Szilard: His Version of the Facts'' by Leo Szilard; Spencer R. Weart (ed.); Gertrud Weiss Szilard (ed.)|author=Phillips, Melba|author-link=Melba Phillips|pages=87–89|jstor=40402222}}</ref>
*[https://books.google.com/books?id=yL-kOJzt0hwC ''Nuclear Fear: A History of Images''] (1989) {{ISBN|0-674-62836-5}}<ref>{{cite journal|title=Review of ''Nuclear Fear: A History of Images'' by Spencer R. *as editor with Lillian Hoddeson, Ernest Braun & Jürgen Teichmann: [https://books.google.com/books/about/Out_of_the_Crystal_Maze.html?id=WCpPPHhMdRcC ''Out of the Crystal Maze: Chapters from the History of Solid State Physics''] (1992). {{ISBN|0-19-505329-X}}<ref>{{cite journal|author=Steinfink, Hugo|title=Review of ''Out of the Crystal Maze: Chapters from the History of Solid State Physics'' edited by L. Hoddeson, E. Braun, J. Teichmann & S. *''[[The Discovery of Global Warming]]'' (2003, 2008). [http://history.aip.org/climate Online extended version]. {{ISBN|0-674-03189-X}}
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=9KBD-YrGOVkC ''The Rise of Nuclear Fear''] (2012). {{ISBN|978-0-674-05233-8}}

While at AIP he also produced and edited an award-winning website with historical exhibits.
